description: This file contains a PHP unit test class 'EmployeeImmigrationRecordAPITest' which tests the API endpoints for managing employee immigration records in a Human Resource Management system. Tests include retrieving, creating, updating, deleting immigration records, and verifying validation rules.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the functionality, validation, and integration of the EmployeeImmigrationRecord API endpoints related to employee immigration records.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeImmigrationRecordService
methods.description: Verifies that the API correctly returns an instance of EmployeeImmigrationRecordService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests fetching a specific employee immigration record and checks the returned data structure and values.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for the 'getOne' API endpoint, ensuring correct request parameters.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the deletion of an employee immigration record and expects the record to no longer be found.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for the 'delete' API endpoint.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing employee immigration record and verifies the updated data.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for the 'update' API endpoint.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new employee immigration record and verifies the returned data.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for the 'create' API endpoint.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all immigration records for an employee and checks the returned list and metadata.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for the 'getAll' API endpoint.
